sections.description:
RECRUITMENT RULES OF ARMED FORCES
RECRUITMENT RULES OF ARMED
FORCES
INSTITUTE OF CARDIOLOGY
(AFIC). RAWALPINDI
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
9th February, 2012]
S.R.O.
133(I)/2012, dated 1-2-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by Sub-Rule
(2) of Rule 3 of the Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer)
Rules, 1973 and section 7(11)(b)(i) & (ii) of the FPSC Ordinance 1977 (XLV
of 1977), following amendments shall be made in the Recruitment Rules of Armed
Forces Institute of Cardiology (AFIC), Rawalpindi under the Ministry of Defence
notified vide S.R.O. 48(KE)/92 dated 28th January 1992, as amended from time to
time, namely:--
In
the aforesaid Recruitment Rules:--
(i) In
schedule, under Column 3:
(a) The
existing entries at clause (ii) against Serial Nos. 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 shall
be omitted.
(b) The
existing entry at clause (iii) against Serial No.10 shall be omitted.
2. This
Notification issues with the approval of the Establishment Division vide O.M.
No.4/5/89-R-5, 26-12-2011 and FPSC vide its letter No.F. 15-01/2012-RR dated
19th January, 2012.
